### Namespace `Hawkynt.NativeForms.Backends.Windows`

[`Win32Backend`](#win32backend)

#### `Win32Backend`

The Windows (Win32/USER32) implementation of `IPlatformBackend`. It manufactures native peers and pumps the classic `GetMessage`/`TranslateMessage`/`DispatchMessage` loop. The type compiles on any OS; `IsSupported` gates it to Windows at run time.

Implements `IPlatformBackend`.
